phases.description: Posizione iniziale in tabletop con spalle sollevate e mani leggere ai lati della testa.
phases.prompt: ONE landscape 3:2 PNG, realistic fitness instruction illustration on warm ivory floor/background, full bodies and all equipment completely visible with generous margin. No text captions numbers panels, only original small Misurami left chest logo. Original character reference attached: reproduce same man face curly hair beard athletic build charcoal shirt and shorts yellow stripe black shoes. Anatomically exact limbs hands joints, natural supported posture. Exercise bicycle crunch PHASE 1 initial tabletop. Misurami man supine on floor, head toward left feet toward right. Lumbar back and pelvis supported on floor, shoulders lifted a small comfortable amount, chin neutral not tucked hard. Both hips flexed 90 degrees with thighs vertical, knees bent 90 degrees with both shins horizontal parallel floor, feet lifted. Fingertips rest gently at sides of head above ears, elbows open, DO NOT pull on neck. Two full legs separated in projection so both bent knees and shoes readable, correct joints and hands. Elevated side three-quarter camera showing front/left chest original logo. Entire body with generous margins and ample space right for later extended leg. No equipment, no arrows.

phases.description: Pedalata con gamba vicina alla camera piegata e gamba opposta distesa.
phases.prompt: ONE landscape 3:2 PNG, realistic fitness instruction illustration on warm ivory floor/background, full bodies and all equipment completely visible with generous margin. No text captions numbers panels, only original small Misurami left chest logo. Original character reference attached: reproduce same man face curly hair beard athletic build charcoal shirt and shorts yellow stripe black shoes. Anatomically exact limbs hands joints, natural supported posture. Exercise bicycle crunch PHASE 2, rotate RIGHT elbow toward LEFT knee. Original character sheet authoritative; second image fixes exact camera lighting floor and character size. Keep lumbar back and pelvis supported at SAME floor point, fingertips lightly at sides of head, no neck pulling. Change pose: LEFT knee flexes toward chest while RIGHT leg extends almost straight hovering above floor toward right; trunk rotates so RIGHT shoulder lifts and RIGHT elbow approaches LEFT knee without forcing touch. Do not bring same-side elbow/knee together. Clearly two legs, one straight right leg and one bent left leg; two arms both elbows open. Full extended right shoe visible with margin; if needed use existing side space without cropping or changing camera/scale. No arrows text captions.

phases.description: Pedalata opposta con gamba vicina distesa e ginocchio opposto raccolto.
phases.prompt: ONE landscape 3:2 PNG, realistic fitness instruction illustration on warm ivory floor/background, full bodies and all equipment completely visible with generous margin. No text captions numbers panels, only original small Misurami left chest logo. Original character reference attached: reproduce same man face curly hair beard athletic build charcoal shirt and shorts yellow stripe black shoes. Anatomically exact limbs hands joints, natural supported posture. Bicycle crunch OPPOSITE LEG position. Edit second image. Keep same camera fixed pelvis head placement scale clothes. CRITICAL: the leg with yellow outer shorts stripe nearest viewer MUST NOW EXTEND STRAIGHT from hip diagonally right across lower image; the OTHER leg partly behind it MUST BEND at knee pointing up and toward chest. This changes leg assignment from original. Make near straight leg clearly OVERLAP in front of bent far thigh at hip, not behind it. The near RIGHT shoulder and elbow rotate toward the far bent LEFT knee; chest turns away camera, logo may be occluded naturally. Both fingertips at temples, no pulling neck. Full shoes hands body visible. Two arms two legs exactly. Lumbar and pelvis floor supported. This is not mirroring entire image; head stays left feet right. One PNG no labels arrows.

sequenceNotes: Entrambi i lati e ritorno alla posizione centrale; contatto gomito-ginocchio non forzato.
